name: Simulation vs Test: Roles

Test: expensive proof of the chosen design.

name: When to Trust the Test Over the Model
title: When to Trust the Test Over the Model
description: Tests can be wrong too - but a well-executed test outranks a model in conflict. The rule: trust validated tests over unvalidated models; distrust both equally when neither is validated.
how_it_works: Validate the test (calibration, procedure, repeatability) before crowning it; then use the discrepancy to improve the model. If the test is suspect, fix the test - don't tune the model to bad data.
key_points: Validated test beats unvalidated model.
Validate the test before trusting the discrepancy.
Never tune models to bad test data.
Both need validation; the better-validated wins.
